title: Blank-slate entry clickthrough per surface on one template
notes: Objective: creation-vision (entries pass; gated: do after the conform pass). From study-tasks.json entries-pass. Build ONE consistent blank-slate usage clickthrough per surface (Image, UI, Video) using a single shared walkthrough template that embeds the real docked shell in every step (UX-PATTERNS D5). Start from the history/launcher blank slate, click through to the key outcome. Fold old walkthrough pages into the template or move them to Prototypes and Ideas. Do after the conform pass.
acceptance: One shared walkthrough template exists; the Image, UI, and Video entry clickthroughs all use it
Each clickthrough starts from the history/launcher blank slate and reaches its key outcome with the real docked shell visible in every step
Old walkthrough pages are folded into the template or moved to Prototypes and Ideas in index.html; no orphaned rail links
